about: Datasets for the 4D page. base is the one place the index's home is named: when a group moves to its own repository, change base, or give that entry its own base. A #base= hash key overrides it for a session. iso_step spaces the contour lines (iso mode); a layer that clears below its range also gets a line at the low end, the ice edge. form cog reads one COG per time step (listed by the dataset's STAC items) at the overview nearest width cells wide; stamp start says each time stamp opens its period (monthly composites); scale log10 spaces the palette over the logs of the range.

relay.about: Hosts that send no CORS header, read through a relay when template is set (or a #relay= hash key gives one): {url} in the template is the original URL, {encoded} the URL encoded as a query value, and with neither the URL is appended. The relay must pass Range headers. Reads are still counted under the original host.
